summary: The recorded base reproduces the exact Forward Pass Metrics TypeError when a pure decode batch has seq_lens_cpu=None. The exact candidate falls back to req.seqlen, passes its complete 21-test FPM suite, and passes independent adversarial checks for a missing mirror, a populated torch.int64 CPU mirror that must remain authoritative, and an empty decode batch. The source change fully resolves the scheduler-side contract in the original issue; deployment-specific B200/GLM/NSA/TRTLLM and Gloo cascade behavior was not reproduced.

gpu_execution.evidence: The exact failure is CPU-side metric aggregation and was exercised through the real SchedulerMetricsReporter emit path without a GPU kernel. The assigned host exposes one gfx950 AMD Instinct MI355X, whereas the report used 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs. No GPU or distributed execution is claimed.

remaining_limitations: The original 8x NVIDIA B200, GLM-5.1, NSA/TRTLLM, DP-attention distributed deployment was unavailable, so the full serving workload was not reproduced.
The downstream multi-rank Gloo failure cascade was not reproduced on the assigned single gfx950 AMD Instinct MI355X.
